🪶 BROODWING: Bird Survival & Roleplay 🪶
Live the life of a wild bird! Fly, hunt, build a nest and raise your own family of baby birds with friends.

🦅 Play as a bird!
🥚 Build a nest, lay eggs and raise cute chicks
🐣 Hatch as a baby bird and grow up into an adult
🐟 Hunt fish and bunnies across a huge valley
👪 Join a family and roleplay together

🐦 More birds coming soon!
